scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @sa/sidecar build && corepack pnpm build:agent && install-electron && corepack pnpm install:chromium && node scripts/run-electron-vite.mjs dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @sa/sidecar build && corepack pnpm build:agent && electron-vite build
scripts.preview: corepack pnpm --filter @sa/sidecar build && install-electron && corepack pnpm install:chromium && node scripts/run-electron-vite.mjs preview
scripts.package: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --publish never
scripts.package:dir: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.package:mac:app: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --mac dir -c.mac.notarize=false --publish never
scripts.package:win: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:msix: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --win appx --x64 --publish never
scripts.smoke: corepack pnpm --filter @sa/sidecar build && install-electron && node scripts/smoke.mjs
